name: Brasil TecPar (Selko)
name_long: Brasil Tecpar Servicos de Telecomunicacoes S.A.
notes:
This ASN is part of **Brasil TecPar**, a Brazilian telecommunications group providing broadband Internet, corporate connectivity, transport and IT infrastructure services. The company operates multiple ASNs to support its regional networks, enable traffic, and integrate networks acquired through its ongoing expansion strategy.

Our main peering/transit ASN is [**AS53062**](http://as53062.peeringdb.net/).

We operate multiple ASNs dedicated to eyeball/access traffic. A complete and up-to-date list of these ASNs can be found at **AS53062:AS-MNA**.

*For detailed peering policies, please refer to:*
[https://bgp.as53062.net.br/policy](https://bgp.as53062.net.br/policy)
